### He Alone Is Worthy - Love Worth Finding - January 8
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-january-8-2019.html
Passage: Revelation 5:12
Points:
- True worship is acknowledging that God is the Master and that He alone is worthy.
- Just as an old violin belongs in the hands of the master musician, all honour rightfully belongs to Christ.
- Believers are encouraged to cultivate personal praise by listing God's attributes for all that He is, has been, and will be.

### Praising the Lamb
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/praising-the-lamb
Passage: Revelation 5:11-14
Points:
- Creation groans under the curse, which is overcome solely through the redemptive work of Christ.
- Countless angels encircle the throne to declare that the slain Lamb possesses infinite, unquantifiable worth.
- Every created being in the universe will ultimately unite in offering praise, honor, and glory to God and the Lamb.
- Believers are called to participate in this eternal praise today through both private and corporate worship.
